text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Yushun Himba (Oaks). To 
perfect her love for racing, Mejiro Ramonu 
accepts her Trainer's race plan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, she receives a declaration of 
war from an Umamusume of her generation 
whom she also faced in the Oka Sho. Mejiro 
Ramonu responds with a taunt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wishing for the race to be all the more 
fierce, Mejiro Ramonu took on the 
challenge of the second Tiara crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wishing for the race to be all the more 
fierce, Mejiro Ramonu took on the 
challenge of the Oak Crown.
